WITH bucket_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    o.timespan,
    COUNT(*) as bucket_count
  FROM riskandmargin rm
  INNER JOIN orders o ON rm.ordervault = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.timespan
),
total_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(bucket_count) as total_count,
    COUNT(*) as num_buckets
  FROM bucket_counts
),
bucket_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    bc.bucket_count,
    CAST(bc.bucket_count AS NUMERIC) / CAST(ts.total_count AS NUMERIC) as share,
    CAST(1.0 AS NUMERIC) / CAST(ts.num_buckets AS NUMERIC) as avg_share
  FROM bucket_counts bc
  CROSS JOIN total_stats ts
),
filtered_buckets AS (
  SELECT 
    bucket_count,
    share,
    avg_share
  FROM bucket_shares
  WHERE share > avg_share
)
SELECT 
  SUM(bucket_count) as total_count,
  AVG(share) as their_avg_share,
  AVG(share - avg_share) as avg_above_avg
FROM filtered_buckets

assumptions.assumption: NULL timespan values are grouped as a single bucket (standard SQL GROUP BY behavior)
NUMERIC division is supported for unrounded precision arithmetic
Result may be NULL/empty if no buckets exceed average share (e.g., all buckets have equal counts)
